name: ui-design-component-templates
description: Static library of starter component templates (shadcn/ui conventions on Radix UI + Tailwind). Not a semantic cache: lookup is by component name. Templates are a starting point, not a certification.

cache_policy.lookup_trigger: When the request needs a standard button, dialog, input or card and the project has no equivalent component yet.
cache_policy.cache_hit_action: Adapt the template to the project's conventions. A template never replaces verification: run the accessibility gate on the assembled screen.
cache_policy.cache_miss_action: Build the component from the project's own primitives and the component contracts reference.
cache_policy.theme_contract: Templates use semantic Tailwind colors (background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, accent, muted, card, border, input, ring) backed by CSS variables, as in shadcn/ui. If the project lacks them, map these names to its tokens and validate the pairs with the ui-ux.tokens gate.
cache_policy.target_size_policy: Default controls are 44px (touch). The compact `sm` size is 36px for dense desktop UI; never go below 24px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).

button.name: Button
button.accessibility_contract: Native <button> with type=button by default; 44px default and icon sizes, 36px compact size (>= 24px, SC 2.5.8); visible :focus-visible ring. Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Contrast depends on the project theme and must be checked.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.accessibility_contract: Radix Dialog supplies focus trap, Escape to close, focus return and aria-labelledby/aria-describedby wiring. Template adds a 44x44px labelled close button with a visible focus ring, logical (RTL-safe) positioning and reduced-motion handling. Always render DialogTitle and DialogDescription.

input.name: Input
input.accessibility_contract: 44px height, 16px text on mobile (prevents iOS zoom), visible focus ring, aria-invalid styling. Requires a visible associated <label>; errors linked with aria-describedby.

card.name: Card
card.accessibility_contract: Semantic surface colors; heading level is configurable so the page outline stays valid. A clickable card must not contain nested interactive controls.
